name: R25 the jump comes to the thumb that is already busy
description: a second finger landing while another is held arms the kicker, so the hand on the throttle never has to hunt for the jump band; the mid-run prompt says TAP TO JUMP rather than naming a key a phone does not have. Ceiling is on the GATE's basis (--O1, randomised roadroller search, 15-iteration zopfli), whose spread is ~70 bytes. The 13,312 limit applies to the submission basis (strands:ship, --O2): 13,298 best of three packs, with packs landing over it - pack repeatedly and submit the smallest.
